Good morning all,
The arrivals lead discussed a point about calm handling before opening, and I wanted to pass it on.

Please keep our tone steady and reassuring when speaking with travelers, especially when a pet is newly arrived or appears unsettled. The welfare coordinator will continue to review comfort needs and flag any observations that may help us support a smoother handoff. If a case becomes complex, please keep communication prompt and respectful so the traveler knows we are attentive and acting with care.

A brief note on the recent delayed departure is included here for the team record. <<FACT F109>> Please ensure any follow-up notes remain factual, brief, and focused on the animal's welfare and the traveler's experience. When we stay consistent in our wording, we help reduce stress and keep our service aligned with Aurelia Skyways standards.

Thank you for the thoughtful work you do each day. Your calm approach makes a meaningful difference for every traveler and every pet we assist.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
